inputs.name: zeek_series
inputs.description: Zeek release line to install, such as "9.0". The host gets the newest release on that line. X.0 lines are Zeek's long-term support releases.

inputs.name: interface
inputs.description: Network interface Zeek listens on. A host object's interface overrides it for that host.

inputs.name: networks
inputs.description: Networks Zeek treats as local, in CIDR notation, such as ["192.168.1.0/24"]. Private address space counts as local without being listed.

inputs.name: json_logs
inputs.description: Write Zeek's logs as JSON, one object per line, instead of tab-separated values.

inputs.name: log_rotation_interval
inputs.description: Seconds between log rotations. Each rotation moves the current logs into a dated directory under /opt/zeek/logs. 0 turns rotation off.

inputs.name: log_expire_days
inputs.description: Days rotated logs are kept before zeekctl cron deletes them. 0 keeps them for good.

inputs.name: local_zeek
inputs.description: Zeek script lines loaded after the package's local.zeek, such as "@load policy/protocols/conn/mac-logging".
